overview.description: The Teucrium 2x Daily Corn ETF (CXRN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in corn commodities. The fund is an actively managed fund that seeks 200% the daily price performance of corn futures. The fund invests via a subsidiary that holds the contracts CXRN was launched on Dec 12, 2024 and is issued by Teucrium.

data.title: Widespread Drought Adds to Stresses for U.S. Farmers. Food Prices Are a Focus.
data.text: Just in time for the start of the growing season, the National Drought Mitigation Center's latest data says that 51% of U.S. states and Puerto Rico are in moderate drought or worse.
